title: Pump Seal Swap

steps.glance: Remove four M6 gland nuts with 10 mm socket
steps.body: Remove the four M6 gland nuts with the 10 mm socket. Keep the nuts for reuse.
quotes: 3.1 Remove the four M6 gland nuts with the 10 mm socket. Keep the nuts for reuse.

steps.glance: Lift gland plate and discard old O-ring
steps.body: Lift the gland plate off the shaft and discard the old O-ring.
steps.warning: Do not reuse the old O-ring.
quotes: 3.2 Lift the gland plate off the shaft and discard the old O-ring.
Do not reuse the old O-ring.

steps.glance: Fit new O-ring HX2-311 into seal housing groove
steps.body: Fit the new O-ring HX2-311 into the groove of the seal housing. Fit it dry.
steps.warning: Do not lubricate the new O-ring.
quotes: 3.3 Fit the new O-ring HX2-311 into the groove of the seal housing. Fit it dry.
Do not lubricate the new O-ring.

steps.glance: Refit plate and torque M6 gland nuts to 4 N-m
steps.body: Refit the gland plate and torque the four M6 gland nuts to 4 N-m in the order shown in Figure 1: upper left, lower right, upper right, lower left.
quotes: 3.4 Refit the gland plate and torque the four M6 gland nuts to 4 N-m in the order shown in Figure 1: upper left, lower right, upper right, lower left.

steps.glance: Check gap with 0.20 mm feeler gauge
steps.body: Check the gap under the gland plate with the 0.20 mm feeler gauge at all four corners. The gauge must not enter.
quotes: Check the gap under the gland plate with the 0.20 mm feeler gauge at all four corners.

steps.glance: Run pump for 30 s at 1200 rpm and check seal
steps.body: Restore power and run the pump for 30 s at 1200 rpm. Check the seal for drips. Any drip is a nonconformance: report it under SOP-140.
quotes: Restore power and run the pump for 30 s at 1200 rpm. Check the seal for drips. Any drip is a nonconformance: report it under SOP-140.

warnings: Isolate power and drain the pump before opening the seal housing.
Do not reuse the old O-ring.
Do not lubricate the new O-ring.
